args.title: Juniper Labware: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a blog article and a companion piece (free email registration, no password).
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/returns/companion): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
